placements.why: Both EXISTING STRATA and EXISTING GRAPH STRUCTURE are empty for this repo, so no organizational category exists yet to hold an engineering infrastructure/technology-choice decision. src-1 performs a database-layer swap ('We're switching from PostgreSQL to QuantumDB for the analytics pipeline') — a core system-architecture action, not a strategy, product, or proof-point matter. Nothing supplied is even close (EXACT and INSPIRED both fail on an empty structure), so this is a NEW, standalone top-level category with no parent required, matching the role's own example vocabulary (Opportunity/Strategy/Product/Architecture/...).
placements.title: Engineering infrastructure and system-architecture decisions
placements.frame: What core technical infrastructure or system-architecture choice is being made here, and what tier of the organization owns it?

placements.title: Core infrastructure is swapped and ratified on quantified performance/cost grounds
placements.frame: When a technical infrastructure or platform component is replaced, is the decision being enacted as already settled, and is its justification carried entirely by quantified performance and cost metrics rather than qualitative or risk-based reasoning?
placements.why: src-1 enacts the PostgreSQL-to-QuantumDB switch in present-tense ratification language ('We're switching') rather than proposing it — decision-grade, not argued-for. src-2 supplies the entire rationale as two flat metrics, performance and licensing cost ('10x query performance, lower licensing cost'), with no other justification offered. src-3 memorializes both the settling and the metric-driven justification into a structured recap with a concrete timeline. Together these three expressions are not a one-time fact to file as evidence elsewhere — they establish a recurring pattern this repo's engineering decisions plausibly keep exhibiting (infrastructure swaps ratified via performance/cost framing), which is exactly the kind of subject future envelopes would keep feeding, per the narrative grain test. No existing leaf could hold this (structure is empty), so it mints fresh under the newly-minted Architecture stratum rather than standing parentless, since Architecture is the exact organizational home for this theme.
